top_signals.title: Gold Gains as Traders Weigh Fed Rate Path Amid High Yields
top_signals.summary: Gold recovered some losses from Monday’s rout as traders looked for clues on whether the Federal Reserve will continue tightening policy to rein in inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 29
top_signals.summary: Oil fell as top exporter Saudi Arabia boosted flows through a key pipeline, overshadowing concerns over a US-Iran stalemate.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Banks Draw $11.5 Billion of Demand for Paramount Loan Deal
top_signals.summary: Banks led by Citigroup Inc. have attracted about $11.5 billion of investor orders for the roughly $7.5 billion of loans to help fund Paramount Skydance Corp.’s acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., paving the way to get the syndication over the finish line.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: New Zealand, Australia sign pact to deepen naval cooperation

top_signals.title: EU support to research and innovation increases with additional €500 million for research programme Horizon Europe*
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 Sep 2026 Today, the European Commission allocated an additional €500 million to Horizon Europe, the EU's flagship research and innovation programme, for 2026 and 2027.
